'''Queblux Power Trains''' were a necessary component in fusion generators. The generator at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] had a Queblux Power Train.<ref name="GG7" />
